description: Migrate LLM application code and prompts to Amazon Nova 2 Lite (boto3 Bedrock Runtime). One plugin with a shared Nova target and per-source guides for Google Gemini (google-genai / google-generativeai) and Anthropic Claude (Anthropic Messages API or Claude-on-Bedrock). Handles SDK conversion, prompt reformatting, tool calling, structured output, multimodal, and reasoning migration.
name: nova-migration
